'''Tiranga's Loft''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Tiranga]]. Rumor had it that [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was a co-owner of the Loft, but such rumors were unsubstantiated.
